summary: The research study will examine the renewed German attempt to bypass Soviet-held Tula and the roads, rivers, defenses and supply problems shaping the southern pincer.
location: Tula, Venev and the Kashira approaches
outlineTopics: German 2nd Panzer Army under Heinz Guderian.
Soviet 50th Army and its defensive responsibilities.
The importance of Tula as an industrial and transportation center.
German armored formations operating east and southeast of Tula.
The role of Soviet antitank defenses and local military formations.
German attempts to move toward Venev and Kashira.
The railway and road network connecting Tula with Moscow.
The Oka River and its operational significance.
German losses, mechanical failures, and supply difficulties.
Why the German southern envelopment failed to develop as originally intended.
The relationship between the southern offensive and German advances north of Moscow.
